provenance.post_title: A Lodge in the City of Strangers
provenance.asset_description: two characters overlayed over the top of a blurred background. on the left is a kitsune woman with well-groomed fur, brightly colored clothes, and round spectacles is ready to take notes, quill in hand. The character on the right is a dragonfly-winged sprite smirking confidently, her violet eyes gleaming. She wears the trappings of a powerful mage, as well as a finely wrought staff sized for someone her diminutive size
